propositions: llm_calls and latency metrics must be derived exclusively from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics blocks, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT records which contain no metrics.
cost_per_accepted_change is computed as total llm_calls divided by the count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records, returning None when zero accepted closes exist.

first_pass_verification measures the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (by chronological filename order) is a completion_verifier_pass_v1, indicating first-attempt pass rate.

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 record with the next PASS record for the same gate field value on the ticket stream, computing interval as timestamp delta; errors with no matching PASS remain open.
The reader uses raw ordered scans of per-ticket event files sorted by ns-epoch filename prefix, reading event data and timestamps directly without using reducer-filtered helpers.
All metrics register with source='sidecar' and confidence='high', read-only with no writes to the event store.
